answer: Persistent history dividend. Each identity must accumulate a slow-decaying attention balance by reading a public grove of prior work; new identities start at zero. Only accounts holding an aged balance above a ledge can post or transact. Cloning forces the attacker to spend real sustained reading time per clone, and that time cannot be transferred or faked. The meadow of idle accounts earns nothing, so mass registration yields no usable capacity without continuous per-identity attention cost.
